rule: Never overwrite a tested specification. Every material hyperparameter or feature change gets a new experiment_id, including failed runs.

notes: Real-data fits showed material EM non-convergence across multiple initializations.
Kept permanently as a failed diagnostic; do not tune it into a winner.

experiments.state_model: RobustScaler -> PCA(4, whitened) -> sticky VariationalGaussianHMM; forward-filtered decision posterior
experiments.return_model: overlapping 20d forward log returns, state weighted and shrunk
experiments.optimizer: expected log wealth with CVaR95, turnover and mean-estimation uncertainty penalties

oos_result.interpretation: Optimizer selected cash at every OOS decision. This is not evidence of a superior risk model; the specification is too data-limited and structurally conservative to be useful.

known_limitations: 20d forward-return labels overlap heavily, overstating effective independent sample size.
Free BTC-dominance history used by the current data source limits the first eligible OOS decision to 2025-06-01, which is too short for intended cycle validation.
The full OOS run chose zero exposure at every decision.
This specification remains frozen as a rejected diagnostic and must not be silently altered.

experiments.state_model: training-only robust scaling -> 4-factor dimension reduction -> sticky variational regime model -> forward filter
experiments.state_return_model: state-conditioned DAILY asset log returns with shrinkage and heavy-tailed innovations
experiments.scenario_engine: simulate 20 sequential days: sample next latent state from transition matrix, then sample that state's multivariate daily return; compound the path
experiments.optimizer: risk-constrained log-growth; CVaR in MVP, CDaR/MPC only after OOS validation
why: eliminates overlapping 20d labels as pseudo-independent observations
uses the Markov transition structure inside the actual future-path generator
allows state changes within the 20d horizon instead of assuming one current regime for all 20 days
makes path drawdown and later CDaR optimization statistically natural
experiments.data_requirement: full-history BTC dominance or a separately registered no-dominance specification; do not shorten training history merely to obtain an earlier backtest start
experiments.selection_status: NO PARAMETER TUNING UNTIL FIRST WALK-FORWARD RESULT IS RECORDED

experiments.state_model: RobustScaler -> PCA(4, whitened) -> sticky VariationalGaussianHMM -> forward filter
experiments.dominance_feature: excluded by design; this is a separately registered price-only ablation, not an alteration of BRRK-MVP-0003
experiments.return_model: state-conditioned daily multivariate log returns with mean and covariance shrinkage
experiments.scenario_engine: 20-day sequential Markov state transitions with df=5 multivariate Student-t daily innovations
experiments.optimizer: expected log wealth with CVaR95, turnover and estimation-uncertainty penalties

oos_result.interpretation: Statistically cleaner than 0002 and low-turnover, but materially underperforms V1 and BTC dynamic beta. Posterior is nearly deterministic and the state-pooled expected-return model loses too much upside information.

experiments.anti_overfit_rule: No parameter change after observing this OOS result without a new experiment ID.
